Team — attaching the diagram and draft threat synthesis (internal). Key highlights to call out to DataGuard: 

- Physical segmentation: Dedicated and Private deployments run on tenant-isolated GPU pools; host OS namespaces + cgroups isolate inference processes. Management plane uses a separate control VLAN with strict ACLs.
- Network paths: Customer plaintext is only present on tenant data plane instances and during controlled peering/VPN sessions. Inter-region replication uses mTLS tunnels with per-connection cert pinning.
- KV cache isolation: runtime enforces tenant-scoped KV namespaces; we persist only encrypted snapshots to object storage. Cache hits use ephemeral keys stored in HSM-backed KMS when requested.
- Lateral movement mitigations: eBPF ingress filtering at the node edge, microsegmentation rules applied by orchestration agent, anomaly detection via flow sampling and tracer.
- Recovery model: automatic evacuation of suspicious nodes, live-migration to warm pool, comprehensive forensic snapshots (disk and in-memory dump policies governed by GPO).

Attachments included: redwood_segmentation_v2.png, isolation-threat-synthesis-draft.md
